primary_inclusion: Only original individually labelled clips for which usable_as_isolated_clip is true in the lossless manifest.
primary_exclusions: All aggregate recordings because the release provides no gesture timestamps and visual audit showed that equal-duration bins do not preserve labels.
All cropped or otherwise preprocessed duplicates.
Any video that fails decoding or label canonicalization.
training_signers: For each fold, every other signer with an original individually labelled clip is included in training.
validation_policy: No validation split and no checkpoint selection. Hyperparameters are common to all models and the final fixed-epoch checkpoint is evaluated once.
test_coverage_requirement: Each held-out signer must contain all 49 classes, with no unseen-label dropping.
pooling_policy: Fold-level results are reported separately. Out-of-fold predictions for S1 and S2 are pooled only after both folds are complete.
